name: LM7915
full_name: LM7915 three-terminal negative 15V fixed linear voltage regulator
description: Negative fixed 15V three-terminal regulator from the 79xx family. Dropout about 1.1V, up to ~1.5A with a heatsink. CRITICAL: the metal tab is electrically the INPUT pin (the negative input rail), NOT ground - the heatsink is live at the negative input voltage.

pins.name: IN
pins.description: unregulated negative DC input (Vi); also bonded to the metal tab

typical_application: Negative 15V rail of a split linear supply, complementing a 7815.
gotchas: pinout DIFFERS from positive 78xx: 79xx front-view is GND-IN-OUT (pin1=GND, pin2=IN, pin3=OUT) vs 78xx IN-GND-OUT
the tab/heatsink is the INPUT pin at the NEGATIVE input potential; it is NOT grounded - isolate it from a grounded chassis/heatsink
input is negative with respect to ground; wiring it like a 78xx will destroy the part and likely the circuit
79xx prefer larger output caps for stability (e.g. ~1uF tantalum) plus an input cap
